title: LLM-Guided Cluster Lifecycle Management: Deciding When and How to Evolve Behavioral Clusters
abstract: arXiv:2611.17616v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Behavioral clusters learned over user or item interactions drift as behavior evolves: some fragment into sub-behaviors, some converge, some disappear, and new patterns emerge. Two paradigms dominate the maintenance of evolving clusterings. Threshold triggers fire a pre-specified action when a hardcoded statistic crosses a cutoff; refit-and-track (MONIC-style) re-clusters every window and infers transitions from how the new clusters align with the previous window's. Both hardwire the decision into a threshold or a re-clustering rule. We study an alternative in which a large language model (LLM) makes the lifecycle decision in place. Given a threshold-free, whole-population view of the current cluster set (statistical health, labels, member texts, residual mass), the LLM decides per cluster whether and how to act (split, merge, retire, create, or no-action) without re-clustering. translated_title: 基于大语言模型引导的聚类生命周期管理：决定行为聚类何时以及如何演化
translated_abstract: 随着用户或物品交互行为的不断演变，基于这些交互学习到的行为聚类会发生漂移：一些聚类会分裂成子行为，一些会融合，一些会消失，同时新的行为模式会涌现。目前维护演化聚类主要有两种范式：阈值触发机制在硬编码的统计量超过预设临界值时触发预定义动作；重聚类与跟踪方法（MONIC风格）在每个时间窗口重新聚类，并根据新聚类与前一窗口聚类的对齐情况推断演化转移关系。这两种方法都将决策硬编码为阈值或重聚类规则。我们研究了一种替代方案：由大语言模型（LLM）直接就地做出生命周期决策。给定一个无阈值、面向全体数据的当前聚类集合视图（统计健康度、标签、成员文本、残差质量），LLM针对每个聚类决定是否以及如何采取行动（分裂、合并、退役、创建或无动作），而无需重新聚类。由于有用的信号通道取决于信息量……
tldr: 该论文提出让大语言模型（LLM）基于无阈值的聚类整体状态视图，就地决策行为聚类的生命周期操作（分裂、合并、退役、创建），从而替代传统上依赖硬编码阈值或重聚类规则的维护范式。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using an LLM to make in-place lifecycle decisions (split, merge, retire, create) for behavioral clusters based on a threshold-free, whole-population view, replacing traditional maintenance paradigms that rely on hardcoded thresholds or re-clustering rules.
